card.name: Reports after post-marketing
card.fires_on: The word reports (or cases) right after 'post-marketing' or 'postmarketing' in warnings sections, just before the named adverse event.

modes.label: Post-marketing reports
modes.description: The noun 'reports' follows 'There have been post-marketing' and introduces an adverse event.
modes.example: 5.2 Pancreatitis There have been post-marketing<< reports>> of acute pancreatitis in patients taking sax

modes.label: Cases or reports as justification
modes.description: 'Reports' or 'cases' introduces a reported problem as the reason for a warning.
modes.example: 5.1 Lactic Acidosis There have been post-marketing<< cases>> of metformin-associated lactic acid
